Subject: BluePeak vendor setup: procurement kickoff + support escalation matrix request

Hi Asha / BluePeak procurement team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for inference. Per our procurement checklist call last week, we wanted to kick off the formal vendor setup so your finance and SRE teams have the information they need to complete the vendor registration and PO.

Could you please confirm the following items to speed things along: 
- Preferred purchase order flow (PO to Redwood AP email, purchase portal, or NetSuite vendor add)
- Billing contact + billing address (for the PO)
- Any vendor onboarding form fields (tax ID, W-9, VAT reg, or other paperwork) you need us to populate
- A named support contact and escalation matrix for production incidents (phone, email, 24/7 on-call, and SLA uptime targets)

We have attached a short vendor info packet and an editable SLA template that you can use to specify uptime targets and escalation tiers. If helpful, we can set a 30-minute sync to walk through the PO steps and DocuSign signature.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf (stub), SLA_template_redwood.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: BluePeak vendor setup: procurement kickoff + support escalation matrix request

Hi Sean / team,

Appreciate the note. We're ready to move forward. Quick answers inline: 
- PO flow: Please send invoices to AP@bluepeak.com and create a NetSuite vendor record — I'll coordinate the vendor add.
- Billing contact/address: BluePeak Technologies, Attn: Accounts Payable, 3100 Harbor Blvd, Suite 200, San Mateo, CA 94404. Invoices to AP@bluepeak.com.
- Onboarding forms: Our procurement portal requires tax ID, W-9, bank details (for EFT), and a signed Master Services Agreement. I've attached our vendor intake form — fill and upload to procureportal.bluepeak.com.
- Support/escalation: We need a primary support email + 24/7 on-call phone for Sev1s, an escalation contact for Sev2 within 2 hours, and an uptime target of 99.9% monthly for the production API. Can you confirm Redwood's on-call approach and the escalation ladder?

I'll also loop in contracts@bluepeak.com to coordinate the MSA. I'm available for a 30-min call tomorrow at 10:30am PT if that works.

Attachments: BluePeak_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf (stub)

Best,
Asha Patel
Vendor Ops Manager, BluePeak Technologies

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@bluepeak.com>, procure@bluepeak.com
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 12:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BluePeak vendor setup: procurement kickoff + support escalation matrix request

Thanks, Asha — this is helpful. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) PO / invoicing
- Invoices: send to ap@redwood.inference.com, payment terms Net30 unless otherwise agreed in SOW.
- We will complete your vendor intake form and upload to procureportal.bluepeak.com by EOD tomorrow.

2) Onboarding forms / legal
- I'll route the MSA (standard Redwood Master Services Agreement) to contracts@bluepeak.com. We can accept redlines, but please flag any unusual liability clauses up front.

3) SLA / support & escalation matrix (requested by BluePeak)
- Primary support channel: support@redwood.inference.com (mon–fri 9am–6pm PT) — for production workloads we provide 24/7 on-call for Sev1 incidents via a dedicated pager.
- Escalation ladder (proposed):
   Tier 1: Support desk (support@redwood.inference.com) — triage within 30 min
   Tier 2: Engineering on-call (pager) — engage within 1 hour for Sev1, 2 hours for Sev2
   Tier 3: Senior SRE escalation (Grace O'Connor) — notify within 4 hours if unresolved
- Uptime targets: 99.9% monthly for the production inference API (we can discuss a 99.95% option under Dedicated capacity with higher SLA and credits).
- Communication channels: status.redwood.inference.com (public incidents), dedicated incident bridge (provided for Sev1).

Action items: 
- Grace, can you populate a concise escalation matrix spreadsheet (names, roles, phone, backup) and share back so BluePeak can attach it to their vendor portal?
- Lauren, I'll need vendor/billing contact for the NetSuite vendor add (tax ID, bank remit info).

I'll block 30m for the DocuSign walkthrough tomorrow at 10:30am PT unless I hear otherwise.

Sean
